Strategy: Leave room for two more. Prefer a bin whose leftover fits two more of this size, keeping it productive for equal arrivals, while exact fits waste nothing and tie at the top. Score by distance from a leftover of twice the item size, so ranking can switch from Best Fit to a bin keeping pair room. It may help by grouping equal items, but may fail by passing up tight fills for bins that later items never pair in.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(abs(r - item - item * 2)) + (item * 2 if r - item == 0 else 0) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Double-size pairing target: score by -abs(leftover - 2*item), exact fits tied at top.
